subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integration tasks, owners, and close plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@novapay.com>; Integrations Team <integrations@novapay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integration tasks, owners, and close plan

Hi Jared / NovaPay integrations team,

Quick MAP checkpoint ahead of Monday's demo — aim is to call out owners, current status, and any blockers so we can keep to the close timeline (target close: 2026-05-07). High-level updates below; full MAP attached (MAP_NovaPay_v1.xlsx).

Summary (short):
- SDK integration (Java + node): in progress, SDK handshake + basic inference calls working on staging — owner: Aditya.
- API auth (OAuth2 + mTLS option): design sign-off needed; edge case on token rotation — owner: Monica.
- Streaming & partial-output: PoC demonstrates streaming tokens to client; need agreed client idle timeout — owner: Rishi.
- Tool calling (external system exec): stubbed in demo harness, requires API contract for webhook signing — owner: Lauren.

Action items (owners & due dates):
1) Aditya: deliver SDK installer + sample app with streaming example to our staging by Tue 2026-04-20 EOD.
2) Monica: send final auth sequence doc (including mTLS config) and token rotation approach by Wed 2026-04-21.
3) Lauren: share signed webhook contract template + HMAC signing snippet by Wed 2026-04-21.
4) Rishi: prepare canary plan for demo routing and fallback to smaller model by Thu 2026-04-22.

Blockers:
- NovaPay's infra team needs confirmation on outbound ports for persistent streaming (WebSocket) — Jared, can you confirm before Tue?
- Marketplace procurement requires a copy of our SOC2 cert and an estimate of monthly tokens for listing — attaching auth_flow_diagram.png and the MAP spreadsheet includes a token estimate section.

Next sync: Mon 2026-04-20 11:00 AM PT (30 min) — agenda: live SDK demo, auth sign-off, decide on streaming idle timeout.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: MAP_NovaPay_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet); auth_flow_diagram.png (diagram)

From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@novapay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Cc: Integrations Team <integrations@novapay.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integration tasks, owners, and close plan

Thanks Rishi — useful summary. Quick answers and notes: 

- Outbound ports for streaming: confirmed we allow 443 outbound for WebSocket/TLS. Our infra lead flagged connection idle timeouts on the load balancer currently set to 60s — we may need a keepalive or ping to avoid disconnects.
- Procurement: will start the marketplace intake this week; I can share the procurement contact (procurement@novapay.com) and they'll need SOC2 and expected spend.

A couple of asks:
1) Can Aditya provide a non-containerized sample (simple npm package) as well as a container image? That helps our devs test locally.
2) For tool calling, we prefer a signed webhook model (HMAC) vs. asymmetric signing; can Lauren provide both options in the contract?

I'll be on the Mon 11 AM PT call.

—Jared
Jared Cole
Senior PM, Integrations | NovaPay
jared.cole@novapay.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>; Jared Cole <jared.cole@novapay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 11:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integration tasks, owners, and close plan

On Mon, Apr 20, 2026 at 08:07 AM Jared Cole <jared.cole@novapay.com> wrote:
> Thanks Rishi — useful summary. Quick answers and notes: 
> - Outbound ports for streaming: confirmed we allow 443 outbound for WebSocket/TLS...
>
Thanks — quick status from my side:
- Node + Java SDK: npm package (redwood-sdk-nova) published to our internal registry (v0.1.0). I attached the quickstart snippet in the MAP spreadsheet (row 14).
- Sample apps: providing both container (docker) and local npm install instructions; container image will be pushed to our staging registry tonight.
- Streaming: implemented keepalive pings every 30s to avoid LB idle disconnects; tested with NovaPay staging LB and held a 20m session successfully.

Blocked on: providing a tiny example that demonstrates tool calling + webhook signing per NovaPay preference — requesting Lauren's contract template to finalize.

Will mark "SDK: in staging" in the MAP and link the registry URL.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Principal Developer Advocate | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@novapay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 07:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integration tasks, owners, and close plan

Hi all,

Auth doc attached — key points:
- Primary: OAuth2 client-credentials for server-to-server calls.
- Optional: mTLS for stricter environments (we included config snippets for nginx and AWS ALB).
- Token rotation: short-lived tokens (15m) + refresh using client assertion; on our side we support automated rotation and will provide an SDK helper.
- Egress IPs and CA bundle: included in the doc; for Marketplace listing we can provide an IP range and public cert thumbprint.

Outstanding: need confirmation from NovaPay on mTLS requirement. If they want mTLS we should schedule a config walk-through (30m).

Monica Patel
Security & Integrations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@novapay.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integration tasks, owners, and close plan

Thanks Jared — attaching the webhook contract template to the MAP (row 22).

Options included:
- HMAC (shared secret) with timestamped nonces — recommended for ease of onboarding.
- Asymmetric signature (RSA) for customers that prefer not to manage shared secrets.

I'll include both code snippets (node, java) and a test harness you can run locally. Expected delivery: Wed EOD (2026-04-21).

Lauren Bishop
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@novapay.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integration tasks, owners, and close plan

Quick close-of-week note after our Monday call and deliverables: 
- Aditya: container and npm package available (registry link in MAP). MARKED: Done.
- Monica: auth doc delivered; NovaPay confirmed no mTLS needed for now. MARKED: Done.
- Lauren: webhook contract + test harness delivered; NovaPay requested HMAC flow — Lauren to share final signed copy with procurement. MARKED: Done (pending signature).
- Streaming: keepalive strategy validated with NovaPay LB. One follow-up: NovaPay asks for recommended client-side reconnect logic for transient errors — Aditya to add a reconnect example (exponential backoff) to the SDK by Mon 2026-04-27.

Next milestones and close timeline:
- 2026-04-27: SDK reconnect example (Aditya).
- 2026-04-29: Legal/procurement receive signed webhook contract + SOC2 export (Lauren / Rishi).
- 2026-05-04: Final eval run with NovaPay test set (Rishi + NovaPay).
- 2026-05-07: Target contract signature and enablement window starts.

If there are any changes to these dates, please flag today so we can adjust the MAP. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
